  S["START"] --> G["coach_gate"]

sequenceDiagram
  participant Member as Member client
  participant Coach as Coach graph
  participant Gate as Deterministic gate
  participant RouteB as Route B agent
  participant Tools as Member tools
  participant Relay as Medical lookup relay
  participant RAG as Healthcare RAG child
  participant Final as Final projection
  Member->>Coach: question or attachment or cron wake
  Coach->>Gate: route scrubbed turn
  alt operational or deterministic safety case
    Gate->>Coach: selected handler
  else ordinary turn
    Gate->>RouteB: safe-projected messages
    alt model calls member tool
      RouteB->>Tools: scoped tool operation
      Tools-->>RouteB: data envelope or result
    else model calls medical lookup
      RouteB->>Relay: query and current config
      Relay->>RAG: invoke full healthcare graph
      RAG-->>Relay: validated answer or refusal
      Relay-->>RouteB: exact medical tool result
    end
    RouteB-->>Coach: projected messages and follow ups
  end
  Coach->>Final: sanitize terminal channel
  Final-->>Member: messages and follow ups

flowchart TD
  Upload["member upload request"] --> Reserve["owner and thread bound reservation"]
  Reserve --> Extract["validate and extract proposal"]
  Extract --> Review["claim operation and review interrupt"]
  Review -->|"accepted safe fields"| Profile["scrubbed profile records"]
  Review -->|"declined or unsafe"| Discard["no profile write"]
  Reminder["reminder tool"] --> Pending["inactive reminder record"]
  Pending --> Cron["authenticated remote cron"]
  Cron --> Active["active reminder record"]
  Active --> Wake["validated server cron wake"]
  Erase["self-erasure request"] --> Gate["write erasing gate"]
  Gate --> Remote["remove crons and upload reservations"]
  Remote --> Delete["privileged member store deletion"]
  Delete --> Marker["confirmation marker when remote cleanup is complete"]
  Marker --> Threads["client deletes non-current threads then current thread"]

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client as Member client
  participant Auth as Authentication hook
  participant Boundary as Member perimeter
  participant Service as Coach service
  Client->>Auth: request with credentials
  Auth->>Boundary: authenticated principal
  Boundary->>Boundary: validate route, body, and ownership
  Boundary->>Service: admitted request
  Service-->>Boundary: response or state
  Boundary-->>Client: allowed response or projected state

flowchart TD
  Start([START]) --> Gate["safety_gate"]
  Gate -->|"refusal or direct response"| Final["finalize"]
  Gate -->|"tool decision"| Query["generate_query_or_respond"]
  Gate -->|"safe retrieval path"| Clarify["clarify_query"]
  Gate -->|"safe retrieval path"| Context["extract_conversation_context"]
  Query -->|"direct response"| Final
  Query -->|"retrieve"| Clarify
  Query -->|"retrieve"| Context
  Clarify --> Decompose["decompose_query"]
  Context --> Decompose
  Decompose -->|"Send parent and capped subqueries"| Retrieve["retrieve_documents"]
  Retrieve --> Merge["merge_retrievals"]
  Merge -->|"initial merge"| Evaluate["evaluate_retrieval"]
  Merge -->|"gap-fill merged"| Generate["generate_answer"]
  Evaluate -->|"one capped gap-fill round"| Retrieve
  Evaluate -->|"otherwise"| Generate
  Generate --> Validate["validate_answer"]
  Validate -->|"validated"| Followups["generate_follow_ups"]
  Validate -->|"not validated"| Final
  Followups --> Final
  Final --> Done([END])

flowchart TD
  Read["Read root and nearest AGENTS.md"] --> Trace["Trace caller state owner boundary and tests"]
  Trace --> Change["Make one bounded behavior change"]
  Change --> Focused["Run focused offline checks"]
  Focused --> Decision{"Does model visible or boundary behavior change"}
  Decision -->|"no"| Review["Review diff and observed failures"]
  Decision -->|"yes"| Real["Run the appropriate real evaluation or integration path"]
  Real --> Compare["Compare equivalent evidence surfaces"]
  Compare --> Review
  Review --> Wiki["Refresh OpenWiki after structural changes"]

flowchart TD

    Template --> Finalize["Finalize scrubbed result"]

    Graph --> Finalize

sequenceDiagram
  participant Browser as Member browser
  participant Supabase as Supabase session
  participant Next as Next chat and proxy
  participant Runtime as CopilotKit runtime
  participant Perimeter as Member perimeter
  participant Graph as Coach graph
  Browser->>Supabase: get or refresh session
  Supabase-->>Browser: member access token
  Browser->>Next: authenticated chat and API requests
  Next->>Runtime: valid bearer request
  Runtime->>Perimeter: forwarded bearer and graph request
  Perimeter->>Graph: authorized scoped request
  Graph-->>Runtime: AG-UI SSE events
  Runtime-->>Browser: streaming response

flowchart TD
    A[routing_gate --lane ...] --> B{smoke or fixture?}
    B -- yes --> C[verdict from canned/fixture evidence]
    B -- no --> R[run_arm per lane arm]
    R --> S1{stage 1: deterministic checks + binding integrity}
    C --> S1
    S1 -- fail --> REJ[ERROR or REJECT]
    S1 -- pass, no stage 2 --> PASS1[stage-1 verdict]
    S1 -- pass --> S2{stage 2: judged benefit + cost and latency ratios}
    S2 -- fail --> REJ2[REJECT]
    S2 -- pass --> OK[PASS + publish report pair]

flowchart TD
  T["release tag"] --> V["verify tag and production policy"]
  V --> B["build GHCR image"]
  B --> M["mirror immutable digest to Fly"]
  M --> S["stage secrets then deploy"]
  S --> R["poll readiness endpoint"]
  R --> SM["deployed smoke"]
  SM -->|"pass"| A["accepted"]
  SM -->|"fail"| F["failed release requires human action"]

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> uninitialized
  uninitialized --> initializing : initialize()
  initializing --> ready : analyzer built + self-test passed
  initializing --> failed : version/model/inventory/sentinel mismatch or build error
  ready --> ready : scan() served
  failed --> failed : subsequent calls raise PRIVACY_NOT_READY

flowchart LR
  R["retrieve_documents node"] --> S["resolve_arm(settings.retriever)"]
  S -->|weaviate default| W["hybrid_search: Weaviate hybrid alpha=0.65"]
  S -->|pageindex| P["pageindex_search: LLM picks tree nodes, then page ranges, then chunks"]
  S -->|pinecone| N["pinecone_search: dense plus sparse, convex-scaled"]
  W & P & N --> RR{"HC_RAG_RERANKER=pinecone?"}
  RR -->|yes| X["rerank_documents: candidates trimmed to top_k, fail-soft"]
  RR -->|no| Q["QueryResultList passed to union_results"]
  X --> Q

flowchart TD
  Q["user message"] --> P["deterministic pre-checks: PHI / injection / identifier recall / red flags"]
  Q --> L["one LLM classification: SafetyAssessment"]
  P --> M{"merge: red flag beats injection beats identifier recall beats LLM"}
  L --> M
  M --> S["scrub_phi: query and checkpoint history"]
  S --> C{"category?"}
  C -->|emergency / personal advice / out-of-scope / injection| T["templated refusal + redirect, follow-ups = []"]
  C -->|in scope / ambiguous| N["pipeline on the SCRUBBED query"]
